prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of a shallow continental shelf — translucent
pale blue water over a visible bed of stone and sand, faint ripples, the
occasional dark kelp patch.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, orthographic top-down view of a shallow continental shelf, translucent pale water over sandy stone bed with dark kelp patches, in aged vellum cream and slate shadow with cool teal accents.

subjects.description: Sandy stone bed visible through translucent water, faint ripple lines across the surface, warm vellum and buff tones beneath the water layer.
Two or three irregular dark kelp clusters anchored to the stone bed, loosely rendered with fine nib strokes, scattered across the tile.
Translucent watercolor wash with soft concentric ripple arcs suggesting shallow tidal movement, cool prismatic shimmer at edges.
